name: obsidian-sync-engine
description: Self-hosted sync engine for your Obsidian vault.

scripts.build: tsc -noEmit -skipLibCheck && node esbuild.config.mjs production && node package-plugin.mjs
scripts.build:dev: tsc -noEmit -skipLibCheck && node esbuild.config.mjs development && node package-plugin.mjs
scripts.version: node version-bump.mjs && git add manifest.json versions.json
